candidates.notes: All text correct. Uses full-width parentheses and half-width 7/4 where the image has half-width parentheses and full-width ７/４; trivial normalisation. Headers and item structure are faithful.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: Text is accurate, with full-width ７/４ and half-width parentheses as in the image. Spacing after the line references, e.g. '(13行目) とありますが', matches the source. Clean structure.

rationale: All five candidates transcribe the text without character errors, so the ranking rests on formatting fidelity. D matches the image most closely in numbering style, digit width and spacing; E is the same minus small spacing details. A normalises parentheses and digit width but is otherwise clean. B adds a horizontal rule and uses H1 headers. C ranks last because it adds redundant list numbers in front of every item.
